goal: Persist and load the nullable awaiting_manual_ordinal lifecycle column across the memory, sqlite, and postgres stores and both schema files, bumping CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION 4->5 with a forward migration that leaves a v4 database readable.

references: src/flywheel/store_sqlite.py:224-226 -- the UPDATE schema_version ... WHERE version = 3 forward-migration step; add the 4->5 step and the ALTER TABLE for the new column
src/flywheel/store_postgres.py:348-350 -- the postgres mirror of the same forward-migration step
src/flywheel/_schema/persistence-schema.sql:206,230 -- the prior nullable-column-add comment and the INSERT OR IGNORE schema_version version = 4; mirror this pattern for the new column and bump to 5
constraints: Add a nullable awaiting_manual_ordinal column to the lifecycles table in BOTH _schema/persistence-schema.sql and _schema/persistence-schema-postgres.sql, and update the schema_version CHECK clause and the seed INSERT version to 5 in both.

Bump CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION to 5 in src/flywheel/store_protocols.py; this is a shared invariant. The existing forward migration is a SINGLE guarded step (store_sqlite.py:224-226, store_postgres.py:348-350: UPDATE schema_version SET version=? WHERE id=1 AND version=3). Add a NEW, additional v4->5 step (ALTER TABLE lifecycles ADD the nullable column, then a guarded UPDATE ... WHERE version=4) rather than editing the existing version=3 guard, so both a v3 and a v4 database migrate forward and a v4 database reads NULL for the new column.
All three stores (store_memory, store_sqlite, store_postgres) must round-trip awaiting_manual_ordinal on save and load.

Enumerate and update every test that pins schema_version 4 or the lifecycle column set: store contract tests must assert round-trip of awaiting_manual_ordinal and that it clears on ->READY/->DONE/->FAILED_VALIDATION; add a migration test asserting a v4 database opens and reads NULL for the new column.
Postgres tests skip without a live database -- do not make them hard-fail; the sqlite, memory, and contract tests are the authoritative graders here.
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every touched .py file and fix all type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No harness logic that sets the column (harness-manual-gate-entry owns that).
No new lifecycle edges (already added by the prerequisite).

graders.run: uv run pytest tests/test_store_sqlite.py tests/test_store_memory.py tests/test_store_contract.py tests/test_store_protocols.py tests/test_store_postgres.py
